content: VRAM budget traps 27B-class on 20GB: Qwen3-32B Q4_K_M weights alone ~19.8GB leaving under 1.5GB for KV+buffers on 20GB card; total run footprint ~weights+KV(defaults to max context)+compute buffers(~0.8-1.2GB runtime overhead); long-prompt prefill spikes compute buffer causing OOM at first big prompt not at load; KV cache quantization q8_0/q4_0 halves KV but costs quality; MoE alternative Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K_M ~18.6GB full-GPU really wants 24GB; --n-cpu-moe/-ot exps=CPU offloads routed experts to CPU with non-monotonic perf effects (can be faster with MORE cpu-offload due to overlap); gradual VRAM growth bugs exist (18506).
